author_or_account: Equimundo: Center for Masculinities and Social Justice
title: State of American Men 2026
discussion_signal: The post presents young men's financial worry alongside personal hope, purpose, connection, and uncertainty about institutions. It resists a single decline narrative: economic insecurity and nostalgia coexist with an ability to imagine a good future, while comments question whether the remembered past is real or constructed.
linked_research_question: How do economic insecurity, online influence, contested masculinity, and institutional trust shape young men's civic and cultural futures?
limits: The post summarizes a report rather than its full sample and methods
Audience comments are not representative young-men opinion
Hope and purpose measures do not establish future civic or economic behavior
